meta.name: TCL Generic
meta.description: A part driven by a Tcl script (TCL Generic protocol); its pins come from the ports of a VHDL entity

tcl.label: Tcl
tcl.title: The Tcl script, the VHDL interface that gives the pins, and the Tcl runtime

status.noRuntime: The Tcl runtime is not loaded; outputs are X. Use "Load Tcl".
status.heldNoRuntime: The Tcl runtime is not loaded; outputs keep their last values. Use "Load Tcl".

runtime.loadTitle: Download the Tcl runtime (wacl, about 5 MB, once) and run the scripts in it
runtime.needed: Scripts run in an in-app Tcl that is downloaded once.
runtime.declined: The Tcl runtime was not downloaded; the script does not run.
runtime.failed: The Tcl runtime could not be loaded: {{message}}

editor.vhdlButtonTitle: Open the VHDL entity that gives the pins
editor.restartTitle: Run the script again from the start (its variables are lost)
editor.loadScriptTitle: Replace the script with a .tcl file
editor.loadVhdlTitle: Replace the interface with a .vhd / .vhdl file
editor.loadFailed: The file could not be read.
editor.scriptHint: logisimForce runs on every tick; examine / force read and set the pins.
editor.vhdlHint: Only the entity's ports are used: in ports become inputs, the others outputs.
editor.saveVhdlTitle: Save the interface as a .vhd file

limits.commands: the script ran too many commands (an endless loop?) and was stopped
limits.time: the script ran too long (an endless loop?) and was stopped

evo.unreadable: Logisim-evolution cannot read this entity ({{reason}}); it stops at an error dialog while opening the file

reason.duplicated: the text has more than one entity
reason.noEntity: it needs "entity <name> is … end <name>;" with the same name, in the same case, and without the word entity after end
reason.portDecl: a port declaration cannot be read
reason.portType: port {{port}}: it reads only std_logic and std_logic_vector(<number> downto <number>)
reason.portMode: port {{port}}: its mode must be in, out or inout

evo.ports: Logisim-evolution reads other pins from the text than this part has; the wires are placed by position, so they will not match
evo.scriptFile: Logisim-evolution runs the script from the file “{{path}}” (its TCL file attribute) in an installed tclsh; the script is stored in the file for this app only and Logisim-evolution drops it when it saves. Save the script as {{file}} (Script… → Save file…) and choose it in Logisim-evolution (a relative path is resolved from the folder Logisim-evolution was started in)
evo.importNoScript: the file has no script for this TCL Generic (e.g. saved by Logisim-evolution, whose script is in “{{path}}”); it starts with the default script, load the .tcl file with Script… → Load file…
evo.importNoPorts: the ports of this TCL Generic cannot be read from its interface; it has no pins until the interface is fixed
